doc.summary: Mutation testing for the MiniOS MCP bridge.
doc.description: Every mutant is injected into a private copy of minios_mcp.py and run against the unit and BDD suite. A mutant that survives (suite fully green) exposes a test gap.  Suites run in parallel (one worker per core, MUTATE_JOBS to override); each mutant gets its own pid file and addon state so the runs stay independent.  Mutation format: "name | sed -i expression | file"

doc.summary: Each mutant runs the suite in its own directory with its own pid file and addon state, so the runs are independent and may execute in parallel.
doc.description: The worker writes the exit code; the loop below maps it onto the verdict.
